text:
Asha: FYI I opened a PR to tighten Dedicated SLA wording and add tiny examples for autoscale + isolation tags. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4372
Ben: I'll review. Two quick asks: clarify preemption vs eviction wording, and include both k8s YAML and terraform snippets.
Rita: Draft k8s snippet (short):
Rita: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
scalePolicy:
  type: target_utilization
  target: 0.65
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
```
Rita: Draft terraform snippet:
Rita: ```hcl
resource "redwood_dedicated_pool" "staging" {
  name = "staging-pool"
  gpu_type = "a100"
  min_capacity = 2
  max_capacity = 10
  isolation = "tenant"
}
```
Asha: Please add a one-line note: "isolation = \"tenant\" -> nodes reserved per tenant; preemption only for emergency reclamation."
Ben: Also add sentence: "Latency SLOs apply to committed capacity; burst capacity is best-effort."
Noah: DocsBot flagged a broken anchor to /docs/dedicated#reserved-pools, I'll fix after wording lands.
DocsBot: link-checker: pending
Asha: OK I'll land wording, then Rita please push the snippets and I'll update anchors.
Rita: Will do in ~20m.
DocsBot: link-checker: passed after anchor fix.
Asha: Thanks all, merging after snippets PR lands.
